claims: The 2026 Masters final round is on Sunday, April 12.
CBS provides coverage of the 2026 Masters final round from 2-7 p.m. ET.
Paramount+ provides early coverage of the 2026 Masters final round from 12-2 p.m.
Paramount+ provides main coverage of the 2026 Masters final round from 2-7 p.m.
Free streaming is available on Masters.com and the Masters App.
Masters.com and the Masters App provide featured groups coverage.
Masters.com and the Masters App provide Amen Corner coverage.
Masters.com and the Masters App provide holes 15/16 coverage.
Masters.com and the Masters App provide the main broadcast.
Paid streaming options include Paramount+, YouTube TV, DirecTV Stream, ESPN App, Prime Video.
Featured holes coverage (Amen Corner, 15 & 16) is available on Masters.com, Paramount+, ESPN App.
Featured Groups coverage is from 10:15 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET on Sunday, April 12.
Amen Corner coverage is from 11:45 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET on Sunday, April 12.
Green Jacket Ceremony is at 7 p.m. ET on Masters.com on Sunday, April 12.
Free coverage on Masters.com is limited to users with a US IP address.
Free coverage on Masters.com requires a VPN for access abroad.
